{{Top|leg}}
An '''Internal Line-slinger''' was a piece of equipment that could be added to [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. It fired a standard twenty-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] line tipped with either a [[magnetic grappler]] or [[claw grappler]]. [[Dej Vennor]]'s armor was equipped with an Internal Line-slinger.<ref name="FOP">''[[The Far Orbit Project]]''</ref>
